links.outcome: 12-month mortality discrimination (AUC) of locally augmented model versus unmodified commercial model
links.effect: Augmenting the commercial EOLCI with local predictors raised AUC from 0.81 (95% CI 0.80, 0.81) to 0.87 (95% CI 0.86, 0.87); SICLI was very well calibrated.
links.quote: SICLI was very well calibrated and outperformed the EOLCI (AUC of 0.87 (95% CI:0.86, 0.87) vs. 0.81, (95% CI: (0.80, 0.81)).

links.outcome: Comparison of new model against existing commercial model on the same data
links.effect: SICLI outperformed the commercial EOLCI on the same cohort: AUC 0.87 vs 0.81.
links.quote: SICLI was very well calibrated and outperformed the EOLCI (AUC of 0.87 (95% CI:0.86, 0.87) vs. 0.81, (95% CI: (0.80, 0.81)).

unlisted_practices: Clinician and informaticist co-selection of the final model for balance of performance and parsimony

screen.reason: The study details the implementation, pilot testing, and governance of an EHR-integrated palliative care mortality model using responsible AI practices, including post-implementation chart review validation by clinicians.

primary.practice: responsible AI framework implementation and post-deployment chart review validation
